hints.title: Column Pair Frequency
hints.text: Two rows share a corner rectangle if both rows have ones at the same two column positions c1 and c2.

hints.title: Single Row Column Enumeration
hints.text: For each row, enumerate all pairs of columns (c1, c2) where both grid cells are one.

hints.title: Pair Accumulation
hints.text: Maintain a frequency map counting how many previous rows have ones at column pair (c1, c2). For the current row, if both columns are one, add the previous count of (c1, c2) to total rectangles and increment the count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Column pair frequency tracking accumulating rectangles formed with preceding rows.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise row checking comparing all (r1, r2) across all columns costs O(R^2 * C) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hashing column index pairs requires O(C^2) space while processing rows in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accumulate combinations dynamically by adding current pair frequency before incrementing.
